name: Danna-sama Daisuki Yuuna-san Emo!
original_name: 旦那様大好き優菜さん・えも！
source:
Our protagonist, 24-year-old businessman Osanai Eisuke, has just married Yuuna, who is five years younger.

A gentle, skilled cook with thoughtful attention to detail, his high-spec wife provides a peaceful newlywed life filled with trivial mishaps.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12394]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
我们的主角，24岁的商人长内荣介，刚刚与小他五岁的悠奈结婚。

他的妻子是一位温柔、技艺精湛、注重细节的厨师，他的高规格妻子为他提供了平静的新婚生活，但也充满了琐碎的小事故。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12394]Novelgame[/url]]
